content:
We have a new release candidate of Lean, v4.35.0-rc1. See the release notes for more information.

The usual repos are all available with the new toolchain at their respective v4.35.0-rc1 tags (and ProofWidgets at v0.0.112). v4.35.0-rc2 will be published within the next few days, so you may want to hold off on updating your project to avoid unnecessary churn.
